scope: Adjustment layers (ADR-0016) through the real server on synthetic still pictures at 640x360 (1080x1920 for the cost sample): stills, exports, undo and replay, a format variant, strobes through the timeline flash schedule (software WebGPU adapter where the machine has one), a GPU effect without an adapter. Not covered: real footage, the editor preview (proof:editor-interactions), a hardware graphics adapter, the owner's laptop.

cost.note: server export, software canvas, this machine under whatever load it had; each per-frame sample is a one-frame export (one frame drawn in a fresh render page, its picture decode included); the mean is the draw stage of one 30-frame export. Recorded, not a target.

checks.name: 1. A whole-edit color.adjust over three full-frame clips equals the same effect on each clip: max |Δ| ≤ 1/255 over every pixel of three stills (one per clip)
2. Opacity 0.5: every byte of the still is within 1 of round((with + without) / 2) (a whole-edit color.invert)

3a. Pixels outside the mask (frame 30, inside the span) and whole frames outside the span (10 and 70): 0 differing bytes against the render without the adjustment; inside the mask the picture is inverted

3b. The pixels the captions cover fully, and those a title on a track above the FX track covers fully (each text alone is equal on a black and on a white background there): 0 differing bytes against the render without the adjustment (a whole-edit color.invert that changes the picture under them). Rim pixels a text covers only partly mix with the picture below; they are counted, not compared
4. The FX track moved above the title track: the title's fully covered pixels differ (> 0); the caption's still do not (captions are drawn last)
5. Still against the exported frame at frames 5, 30 and 55 within the parity-suite tolerance (PSNR ≥ 36 dB and SSIM ≥ 0.985)
6. Undo of the four adjustment edits gives an equal creativeProjection; replaying the op log equals the live document (now and at the edited revision)

7. A variant's hidden override removes the adjustment in that variant's still only: the variant still equals its still before the adjustment (0 differing bytes), the master still keeps it (0 differing bytes from before the override)

8. A strobe on the adjustment (3/s) and a strobe on the clip below (2.5/s): the exported file's flash starts are at least 11 frames apart at 30 fps (the one schedule), they keep flashing (≥ 2 starts a second), and the export's photosensitivity check reports 0 failing ranges

10. Recorded (not gated): draw milliseconds per frame at 1080×1920 with no adjustment and with a whole-edit color.adjust, blur.gaussian 0.01 and overlay.snow (median and p95 over 30 frames, and a 30-frame export mean)

detail.note: server export, software canvas, this machine under whatever load it had; each per-frame sample is a one-frame export (one frame drawn in a fresh render page, its picture decode included); the mean is the draw stage of one 30-frame export. Recorded, not a target.

checks.name: 9. color.grade on an adjustment with the render worker started without WebGPU (PF_RENDER_GPU=off): the export is refused with the adapter reason, and the still too (nothing is delivered without the effect)
